low_donor_support_caveat: Classes with 1 test donor cannot distinguish a real classification signal from that single donor's idiosyncrasies -- treat their precision/recall as a single-patient data point, not a population estimate.

prior_workflow_context.note: Different classes and cohort (LUAD/LUSC/normal, larger balanced 21k-cell design) -- not a head-to-head ranking, only a calibration reference for whether the new SCLC/LUAD/normal model's performance is in a reasonable range.
